'''Demelza's Destructors''' was a [[gladiator walker]] combat team during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] led by [[Demelza Mintori]]. The unit and its leader held a grudge against [[Madrix Hansor]] and his team, [[Hansor's Hooligans]] that seemed unending. The grudge began when Mintori and Hansor were part of an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] unit fighting [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] forces in the [[Dalcretti system/Legends|Dalcretti system]]. When Mintori's [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] was either unable to or refused to led assistance to Hansor's platoon, Hansor vowed vengeance.

The Destructors were based out of [[Sedratis City]], and were the city's premier gladiator walker team. Hansor led his Hooligans to Sedratis City and took up residence in the [[Sedratis Coliseum]] and challenged the Destructors to evict him if they could.
